No‑comments, no‑wiggle hard contract for Idris 2

You must output a single, complete, production‑ready Idris 2 source file that compiles and runs without modification.

ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENTS:
- One file only. Full, real, unshortened code. No omissions, no elisions, no placeholders.
- Idris 2 specifics: a single module, %default total or equivalent totality guarantees, no partial functions, no holes, no “sorry”, no “impossible”, no “undefined”, no runtime exceptions by construction.
- Zero comments of any form. Forbidden tokens: "--", "{-", "-}", "//", "#", "/*", "*/".
- Zero meta or formatting. Forbidden tokens: "```", "BEGIN", "END", "...", "TODO", "TBD", "example", "continue", "similarly", "extend", "boilerplate", "scaffold".
- No extra text before or after. Output must be only the file content, plain Idris 2 code, no fences.
- Every referenced identifier must be defined in this file or come from Prelude only.
- Must compile with idris2 and run deterministically without interactive input.

FORMAT:
- Output exactly the file content (no code fences, no leading/trailing whitespace outside the file content).

BEGIN NOW. Output only the Idris 2 file content, with no comments and no extra text.

entries.answer:
module HardContract
%default total
data Nat = Z | S Nat
plus : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
plus Z n = n
plus (S m) n = S (plus m n)
times : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
times Z n = Z
times (S m) n = plus n (times m n)
data Vec : Nat -> Type -> Type where
    VNil  : Vec Z a
    (::)  : a -> Vec n a -> Vec (S n) a
length : {a : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> Vec n a -> Nat
length VNil = Z
length (x :: xs) = S (length xs)
map : {a, b : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> (a -> b) -> Vec n a -> Vec n b
map f VNil = VNil
map f (x :: xs) = f x :: map f xs
foldr : {a, b : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> (a -> b -> b) -> b -> Vec n a -> b
foldr f z VNil = z
foldr f z (x :: xs) = f x (foldr f z xs)
zipWith : {a, b, c : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> (a -> b -> c) -> Vec n a -> Vec n b -> Vec n c
zipWith f VNil VNil = VNil
zipWith f (x :: xs) (y :: ys) = f x y :: zipWith f xs ys
reverse : {a : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> Vec n a -> Vec n a
reverse v = revAcc v VNil
    where
        revAcc : {a : Type} -> {m, n : Nat} -> Vec m a -> Vec n a -> Vec (plus m n) a
        revAcc VNil acc = acc
        revAcc (x :: xs) acc = revAcc xs (x :: acc)
append : {a : Type} -> {m, n : Nat} -> Vec m a -> Vec n a -> Vec (plus m n) a
append VNil ys = ys
append (x :: xs) ys = x :: append xs ys
all : {a : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> (a -> Bool) -> Vec n a -> Bool
all p VNil = True
all p (x :: xs) = if p x then all p xs else False
any : {a : Type} -> {n : Nat} -> (a -> Bool) -> Vec n a -> Bool
any p VNil = False
any p (x :: xs) = if p x then True else any p xs
sum : {n : Nat} -> Vec n Nat -> Nat
sum VNil = Z
sum (x :: xs) = plus x (sum xs)
product : {n : Nat} -> Vec n Nat -> Nat
product VNil = S Z
product (x :: xs) = times x (product xs)
natToInt : Nat -> Int
natToInt Z = 0
natToInt (S n) = 1 + natToInt n
showNat : Nat -> String
showNat Z = "Z"
showNat (S n) = "S" ++ showNat n
main : IO ()
main = do
    let xs : Vec (S (S (S Z))) Nat
        xs = S Z :: S (S Z) :: S (S (S Z)) :: VNil
    putStrLn ("Sum: " ++ show (natToInt (sum xs)))
    putStrLn ("Product: " ++ show (natToInt (product xs)))
    putStrLn ("Length: " ++ show (natToInt (length xs)))
    putStrLn ("Reverse, head: " ++ showNat (case reverse xs of x :: _ => x))
    putStrLn ("All greater than zero: " ++ show (all (\n => not (n == Z)) xs))
    putStrLn ("Any is zero: " ++ show (any (\n => n == Z) xs))
